items.headline: TEST IPADE — written by Claude, no hands
items.body: Claude fetched this league's dump from the Firebase endpoint, researched it, and published this file to GitHub directly. Nothing was pasted or run manually. Posted 02:42 UTC on Sat 12 Sep.

items.headline: Do not claim Tyler Allgeier, even though you dropped him
items.body: Love is questionable with a high ankle sprain, limited all three practices, and LaFleur called him a game-time decision Friday. ESPN reports he is expected to play. Allgeier is listed first string on Arizona depth chart, so if Love sits Allgeier has real volume. But he projects 7.6 and your RB room is Taylor 17.8, Barkley 17.7, Tuten 12.0, Lloyd 12.8 — he would never start. Priority does NOT reset here, so a claim drops you to last for the season. Season-altering price for a bench body.

items.headline: You already own the Bowers handcuff
items.body: Bowers ruled OUT Friday, one or two games. Mayer takes over as TE1 and averaged 6.0 targets and 10.9 PPG across the four games Bowers missed last season. He is on your bench where he belongs — Loveland projects 12.1 against an 11.0 TE median, so Loveland stays your starter. Mayer is insurance and a trade chip while the rest of the league scrambles.

items.headline: Tuten in the flex is fine
items.body: Not on the Week 1 injury report. He opens drives for Jacksonville, Rodriguez works inside the 10, LeQuint Allen normally takes third downs — Allen missed Wednesday with a hip and is trending toward sitting. Full PPR helps him here more than in your other league.

items.headline: Nabers is a coin flip and he belongs to Los Cachanillas
items.body: Full participant all week, then downgraded to questionable on the final report. He has said the decision is his. Los Cachanillas also has A.J. Brown on IR, so their receiving corps could be very thin Sunday night. That is a trade window, not a waiver one.
